q: He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

q: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth?

s: LORD founded earth (by wisdom)
q: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth.

s: LORD is confidence of son (the addressee) (keeps his foot from being taken)
q: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

q: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her.

s: Wisdom has value better than silver and fine gold (profit and return)
q: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

s: Wisdom is more precious than rubies
q: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

s: Wisdom holds in right hand length of days
q: Length of days is in her right hand.

s: Wisdom holds in left hand riches and honor
q: In her left hand are riches and honor.

s: Wisdom has ways pleasantness and peace
q: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

s: LORD corrects son (the addressee) (as a father reproves the son he delights in)
q: for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

q: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

q: Love her, and she will keep you.

q: Esteem her, and she will exalt you.

q: She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

q: She will give to your head a garland of grace.
